card.name: Space before GHz frequency numbers
card.fires_on: The space or the word "to" just before a radio frequency number in GHz, mostly in lists of ISM bands or microwave circuit material specs.

modes.label: Space before frequency
modes.description: The blank space right before a frequency figure such as 61.0 or 245 that will be followed by GHz.

modes.label: "to" inside a range
modes.description: The word "to" joining two frequency values in a band range.
